The meeting of the Departmental Committee was held through VC on 27/11/2025 at 05 :30 PM to consider the applications received from dependents of deceased employees of DPIIT for filling up 02 vacancies of MTS for the year 2024. The following members were in attendance: I. Shri Susheel Kumar Kalra, Director II. Shri Rajesh Kumar Sinha, Deputy Secretary III. Shri Hemant Kumar, Deputy Secretary - Chairman -Member -Member 2. The committee was provided with copies of relevant records/documents viz. 100 point-scale/marking system, all the information/documents submitted by the applicants, Master Circular on Compassionate appointment issued by DoPT, the details of verified service records (i.e. Initial basic pension/DCR Gratuity/GPF Balance/CGEGIS/ Leave Encashment/ Date of Birth/ Date of Death) of deceased government servants are attached at Annexure-A. 3. The Committee held a detailed examination of the documents, evaluated the applications received for appointment to the post of MTS on compassionate grounds and assigned marks in accordance with the 100-point scale system prescribed by DPIIT vide O.M. No. A-12012/2/2021- Establishment D dated 15.02.2023.
